editorial: Full original drafts reviewed with no-ai-slop; formulas, examples, units and limitations preserved. Separate numerical and editorial review completed.
conventions: Complete-case sample covariance uses ddof=1; matrix rank depends on N and T-1, not merely the parameter count.
Factor covariance with diagonal residual variance imposes zero residual cross-covariance; OLS alone does not impose it.
Shrinkage delta is the weight on the target. Fixed teaching values are not data-estimated Ledoit-Wolf intensities.
Rolling portfolio weights use only returns before the held period.
EWMA initialization, forecast timing and finite-weight normalization are explicit.
Fixed ARCH/GARCH parameters are demonstrations, not fitted forecasts or investment recommendations.
